I have completed the Feed & Discovery Audit for bainluck.com. 

The site generally functions well with excellent event detail pages and rich data visualization, but there are several critical data quality issues that need attention. The most significant findings include placeholder data appearing in live markets (e.g., "Team A" at 50%), unresolved future markets showing exactly 0% or 100%, and a squash player being listed in a major golf tournament.

The complete audit report with detailed findings, health scores, and suggested improvements is attached, along with screenshots capturing the various pages and issues identified during the audit.
